notes.title: Ragdoll: Fall Simulator v1.0 Available!
notes.content:
If more recently, in Ragdoll: Fall Simulator there were only entertaining levels and two characters - a puppet and an astronaut, then with this update we will correct the situation and tell you in more detail about the capabilities of this fall simulator with Ragdoll physics!

To fully release the game from Early Access, we expanded the set of maps, added many characters at once, refreshed the interface and diversified the game music.

[b]Now you can fall off a real rocket![/b]
At the Cosmodrome location, you will have such an opportunity.

[b]Who will accompany the astronaut?[/b]
Play as new astronauts - Red, Green, Blue, White ...

[h3]Be careful at the height, don't fall![/h3]
